title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-02-14
lineage: SBD > MR > DAT > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of the 2/14/70 show with standout Dark Star, Not Fade Away and an acoustic Katie Mae, though the set is incomplete in the archive.
ai_review.review: The recording is a high‑fidelity soundboard (sbd) mix that fans describe as crisp, well‑balanced and with Phil’s bass pushed forward. Musically the concert is praised for its powerful Dark Star, a killer Not Fade Away, an inspired acoustic Katie Mae, and a superb Hard To Handle, even if it falls just short of the previous night’s performance.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers award 4‑5 stars and praise both the mix quality and musical highlights; a few low ratings focus on missing tracks rather than performance, yielding an overall strong but slightly mixed impression.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix is described as crisp with Phil’s bass upfront, balanced band levels and no notable drop‑outs or muddiness. Listeners note the recording sounds “resoundingly exceptional.”

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show is considered very good, though a few fans say it isn’t quite as strong as the 2/13/70 concert. A 12‑minute drum segment is long‑winded but feeds into cosmic jams (NFA > Mason’s > Caution > Feedback) that keep the energy high.

band_member_comments.Phil: Extra presence up front in the mix; praised for an “next level” bass performance on Hard To Handle.
band_member_comments.Bob: Mixed at a competent level, providing solid rhythm and vocals.
band_member_comments.Drums: A 12‑minute drum segment noted as long‑winded but integral to the jam flow.
